title: Ensiform
summary: EN'SIFORM, adjective [Latin ensiformis; ensis, sword, and forma, form.] Having the shape of a sword; as the ensiform or xiphoid cartilage; an ensiform leaf.

inlines.v: EN'SIFORM, adjective [Latin ensiformis; ensis, sword, and forma, form.] Having the shape of a sword; as the ensiform or xiphoid cartilage; an ensiform leaf.
